answer: An agent economy resists sybils by rationing identity through an all-pay auction: each epoch the ledger sells fixed seats, every bid is burned in full, and only the highest bids win. A sybil aiming for the summit pays the clearing price per seat, set by honest competition. Splitting one fortune across many wallets buys nothing: total spend is conserved, so extra identities are wasted money, not standing. The fable that many wallets earn many voices dies when losing bids are jade turned to ash. It caps identities and taxes flooding; a rich attacker can still outbid for seats.
